metadata.title: Entropy and Translation Length in the Ray Graph
metadata.abstract: Let $\Gamma$ be the mapping class group of the plane minus a Cantor set, acting on the ray graph $\mathcal{R}$, and for $\gamma \in \Gamma$ let $\tau(\gamma)$ denote the translation length of $\gamma$ on $\mathcal{R}$. We prove that $\tau(\gamma) \le h(f)/\log(2)$ for every $C^\infty$ diffeomorphism $f$ of $S^2$ representing $\gamma$, where $h$ denotes topological entropy. The proof falls into two parts: a combinatorial argument bounding distance between two rays in $\mathcal{R}$ by the logarithm of the geometric intersection number; and a geometric argument that promotes geometric control (coarse length of iterates of a fixed ray) to combinatorial control (geometric intersection number). We conjecture that the $C^\infty$ hypothesis on $f$ can be removed.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 对去掉 Cantor 集平面的映射类，证明其射线图平移长度不超过代表该类的光滑球面微分同胚拓扑熵除以 log 2。
analysis.breakthrough: 把无穷型曲面映射类的组合平移量与光滑动力系统熵建立显式联系。
analysis.limitations: 代表映射要求 C∞；去掉光滑假设在文中仍是猜想。 数学分析仅依据摘要和评论，未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索及命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 Claude（Anthropic）协助制作图形，并作少量文字编辑和校对；作者负责数学内容。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露 Claude（Anthropic）协助制作图形，并作少量文字编辑和校对；作者负责数学内容。

analysis.priorityReason: 粗几何量与动力系统之间的定量工具具有交叉复用价值。
